pages.text: The Ender Quarry mines the interior of a rectangle while leaving the surface in place. It starts one block below the machine and works downward to the bottom of the dimension.$(br2)Bring four $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:mining/ender_markers)Ender Markers$(/l), a chest, and a source of Forge Energy (FE).
Any sapling fits the top-center slot. The two Ender Thermic Pumps are crafting ingredients.

pages.name: Example Dig Site
pages.text: Click the marker directly beside the quarry. The chest sits on top. Use a free face for power.

pages.title: Start the Quarry
pages.text: $(li)Place four markers on the same Y level, one per corner.$(li)Right-click the corner beside the machine. Wait for $(thing)State: Complete$().$(li)Place the quarry against that corner, outside the rectangle. Right-click it to start.

pages.title: Power and Output
pages.text: Supply FE on a free face. The quarry holds up to $(thing)100 million FE$(). A standard quarry spends $(thing)260 FE per working tick$() and scans one position every 20 working ticks.$(br2)A chest or other inventory can receive items through any adjacent face.

pages.title: What It Leaves
pages.text: Unbreakable blocks and air are skipped. The quarry normally replaces harvested blocks with dirt. Drops that cannot be inserted stay buffered. A full or filtered output stops the quarry until there is space for the pending items.

pages.title: Install Upgrades
pages.text: Put dedicated $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:mining/quarry_upgrades)quarry upgrades$(/l) on free faces. Speed raises the power draw. Silk Touch keeps eligible blocks intact. World Hole replaces harvested blocks with air.$(br2)Leave separate faces free for your power connection and chest.

pages.title: Troubleshooting
pages.text: $(li)Missing marker: align the four corners and click the corner touching the machine.$(li)No progress: check FE, especially after adding upgrades.$(li)Blocked output: empty the chest or open its input side.$(li)Right-click the quarry to see its current state.
